name: Nerfstudio
notes: 2026-10-29: Candidate originated in conversation; listed-in-prd is a legacy listed-only status, not PRD inclusion.
2026-10-29: Documented quickstart requires NVIDIA CUDA; applicability on this macOS machine is unverified. Model and dataset rights are separate.
2026-10-29: Skill opportunity: further research first; assess existing reconstruction skills and reproduce one pinned GPU fixture.

2026-11-24: Hardware: macOS arm64 (Apple M3 Pro, 18 GB, no CUDA). pip install nerfstudio==1.1.5 succeeds; the venv is about 2.1 GB. nerfacto trains on MPS with --machine.device-type mps (MachineConfig default is cuda). The CUDA-only paths (tinycudann, gsplat and nerfacc CUDA kernels) are not exercised.

2026-11-24: COLMAP 4.2.1 renamed SiftExtraction.use_gpu and SiftMatching.use_gpu, which nerfstudio 1.1.5 still passes; ns-process-data needs a flag-rename shim (examples/nerfstudio-feasibility/colmap-compat.sh) on this COLMAP. torch 2.6 and later needs TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD=1 for ns-render of nerfstudio's own checkpoints.
2026-11-24: Toolkit guide written at skills/nerfstudio/SKILL.md from partial evidence (macOS arm64, nerfacto MPS 300 steps; 2 of 20 views registered). CUDA paths and splatfacto untested.

evidence.result: PyPI nerfstudio 1.1.5 installed into a Python 3.12 venv with torch 2.15.0 on macOS arm64, no CUDA. ns-process-data with COLMAP 4.2.1 (through a flag-rename shim) registered 2 of 20 synthetic views, so run.sh fails its 20-frame check. In a separate pass on the same data, nerfacto trained 300 steps on MPS and wrote step-000000299.ckpt; the train split rendered non-blank frames (RGB std about 61 to 63).
evidence.scope: Install and nerfacto 300-step MPS training on macOS arm64 without CUDA; COLMAP registered 2 of 20 synthetic views, so no 20-frame claim; no held-out eval; no splatfacto or CUDA.

summary: Python-based framework and command-line workflows for training, viewing and exporting neural scene representations from image datasets. Its documented quickstart requires NVIDIA CUDA and significant dependencies.
use_when: Research NeRF or Gaussian-splat reconstruction from image datasets
Explore reconstruction workflows with an appropriate CUDA environment
avoid_when: Need a conventional editable 3D model: Blender
Need basic mesh processing without model training: Trimesh
license: Apache-2.0 (project code; methods, models, datasets and dependencies need separate review)

assessment.rationale: Official docs cover reconstruction CLI workflows; PyPI 1.1.5 is dated 2024-11-11. Newer substantive development and model terms remain unverified.
